scope: literal CCM even block m=N=16 only; no F/X or RH certificate

eigensolver.ordering: ascending by real midpoint; returned index i=1 is zero-based second eigenpair
eigensolver.normalization_note: No post-hoc rescaling; stores the eigensolver vector and its Arb norm-squared enclosure.

normalization.method: divide each coordinate by the square root of its Arb norm-squared enclosure

validation.residual_note: Componentwise interval containment of zero is a residual enclosure check only; by itself it does not prove a common exact eigenpair.

limitations: This is one finite even-sector eigenpair and supplies no uniform-in-m input.
The mpmath matrix comparison is floating-point diagnostics, not a rigorous source identity proof.
A finite numerical eigenpair supplies no F/X consumer bound and proves no statement about RH.
The selected vector is an Arb enclosure returned by python-flint; its norm-squared ball is recorded without rescaling.
